- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The most visually stunning historical site in Jodhpur is the Mehrangarh Fort, which is set on a hill and showcases the city's rich cultural and architectural heritage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The fort has majestic walls, intricate carvings, several palaces, temples, and gardens, and offers breathtaking views of the city.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The best times to visit Mehrangarh Fort for views are early morning just after sunrise and evening just before sunset.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visiting during these hours provides perfect lighting for photography and helps avoid the heat of the day.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visiting the fort at night is also a unique experience as it is beautifully lit up.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is excited to see the intricate carvings and majestic walls of the fort up close.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To avoid crowds and enhance the experience at Mehrangarh Fort, the assistant provided several tips:
  1. Arrive early in the morning.
  2. Hire a guide to skip queues and gain insights.
  3. Visit on weekdays to avoid crowds.
  4. Take an audio tour for a self-guided experience.
  5. Bring water to stay hydrated.
  6. Wear comfortable shoes due to many stairs and uneven paths.
- [PREFERENCE] The user plans to arrive early and wear comfortable shoes for the visit.
